headline: Reasonably priced, biggest upside call of the day
chart_note: 52-week range: $289.10 - $426.75. Currently $308.74, about 28% below its high.
why_today: Home Depot trades about 28% below its 52-week high - the biggest pullback of today's four names - as higher rates weigh on home-improvement spending. Every analyst covering it still rates it a Buy.
pro_1: 21 of 21 analysts rate it Buy, average price target of $377 implies about 22% upside - the strongest call of today's batch
pro_2: PE of 22.1x sits right at its 10-year median - not expensive relative to its own history
con_1: 28% drawdown from highs reflects real concern about housing-market-linked demand
con_2: Home-improvement spending is directly exposed to mortgage rates and housing turnover, both currently weak
